E1.evidence: Issue #536 (maintainer vooon, 2016-04-29): "[setpoint_raw] attitude_cb orientation not transformed!" / "@justinthomas found a bug at line 255: https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/blob/master/mavros/src/plugins/setpoint_raw.cpp#L255". PR #537 by justinthomas (merged 2016-04-30, "CI ok. Thank you for bug hunting!"): "Fixes a bug where the ned_desired_orientation was not actually passed into set_attitude_target. Instead, the desired_orientation (wrong frame) was passed." The single-line diff replaces `desired_orientation,` with `ned_desired_orientation,` in the `set_attitude_target(` call of `attitude_cb`. Concrete, maintainer-confirmed defect at code level; no flight log.

E2.evidence: Two separately deployed units: the mavros node and the autopilot firmware, interacting over the MAVLink SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET message that `set_attitude_target` packs with `mavlink_msg_set_attitude_target_pack_chan(UAS_PACK_CHAN(uas), &msg, time_boot_ms, UAS_PACK_TGT(uas), type_mask, q, body_rate.x(), body_rate.y(), body_rate.z(), thrust);` and sends with `UAS_FCU(uas)->send_message(&msg);`. The value in field `q` crossed that boundary in the wrong frame: at 4f31722 `attitude_cb` computes `auto ned_desired_orientation = UAS::transform_orientation_enu_ned(UAS::transform_orientation_baselink_aircraft(desired_orientation));` under the comment "// Transform desired orientation to represent aircraft->NED, // MAVROS operates on orientation of base_link->ENU" but then passes `desired_orientation` (base_link->ENU) to `set_attitude_target`. A wrong frame crossing the boundary is an interface failure even though the resolving edit is inside mavros (step 2 does not stop). Steps 3-5: not a name binding, not a build change, not a firmware fault. Eligible; interface kind: wire protocol field (MAVLink SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET.q).

E3.evidence: PAIR: mavros's output message SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET feeds the FCU's attitude-setpoint input; the defect lies in that hand-off.

E4.evidence: Code-level statement of the mismatch by the fixer and maintainer: "the desired_orientation (wrong frame) was passed" (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/pull/537) and "attitude_cb orientation not transformed!" (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/536). No flight or simulation effect is recorded, so the outcome class is `undocumented`.

units.revision_basis: The source never names the autopilot, its firmware, or its version; the peer is whatever MAVLink FCU receives SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET from mavros. Its only interface statement in the source is mavros's own comment on the frame the message must carry (aircraft->NED). The resolution does not change this unit, so the same label is kept.

failed_conditions.quote: Fixes a bug where the ned_desired_orientation was not actually passed into set_attitude_target. Instead, the desired_orientation (wrong frame) was passed.

loudness_evidence: The defect was found by reading the code ("@justinthomas found a bug at line 255", https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/536); no run, log, or vehicle behaviour is reported, and no MAVLink tooling checks the frame of a quaternion field.

resolution.summary: Provider side: pass the converted quaternion to the packer, `desired_orientation,` -> `ned_desired_orientation,` in `SetpointRawPlugin::attitude_cb` (mavros/src/plugins/setpoint_raw.cpp, commit b96bf67, PR #537). The FCU is unchanged.
resolution.evidence: PR #537 was merged by the maintainer with "CI ok. Thank you for bug hunting!" (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/pull/537#issuecomment-215963555); the source shows no flight or simulation with the fixed composition.

notes: The other composition in the chain, a user node publishing mavros_msgs/AttitudeTarget on `~setpoint_raw/attitude` (subscribed as `attitude_sub = sp_nh.subscribe("attitude", 10, &SetpointRawPlugin::attitude_cb, this);`) in mavros's base_link->ENU convention, is consumed correctly by mavros (the conversion is computed) and is not a failed interaction; the defect is only in what mavros forwards to the FCU. Observation from the parent code, not documented in the source and not addressed by the fix: `attitude_cb` computes `auto body_rate = UAS::transform_frame_baselink_aircraft(baselink_angular_rate);` from an uninitialised vector and then overwrites it with `tf::vectorMsgToEigen(req->body_rate, body_rate);`, so the body rates are also sent untransformed; it is recorded here only as a note. Field names follow the MAVLink common dialect (mavros vendors mavlink_msg_set_attitude_target_pack_chan); `target_system`/`target_component` are filled by `UAS_PACK_TGT(uas)`. The FCU's identity (PX4 or APM) and version are not stated anywhere in the issue or PR.
